mapping_source: Experimenter-confirmed correction on 2026-10-21; supersedes earlier Test 2 receptor labels; raw wells/cells unchanged.
acquisition_date_basis: All 12 export headers state Date: 10/21/2026; clock times have no exported timezone.

user_reported_dilutions.DMSO: 0.1% in the solutions, as stated by the user; stock recipe not independently exported

definitions.response_percent: 100 * (mean of all 15 F1 readings / mean of all 5 F0 readings - 1)
definitions.metric_name: Q21; distinct from the previously reported P2 excursion metric R
definitions.dmso_contrast_pp: Q21 for stimulus minus Q21 for DMSO at the same construct position; different wells
definitions.double_difference_pp: DMSO contrast of construct minus DMSO contrast of blank position 12 for the same stimulus
definitions.f0_sd_over_time_rfu: Sample standard deviation over sequential baseline readings; not biological uncertainty
definitions.f1_sd_over_time_rfu: Sample standard deviation over sequential post-acquisition readings; not biological uncertainty

limitations: One observed well per construct x stimulus (72 wells). Repeated time points do not constitute independent biological replicates.
F0 and F1 are separately exported acquisitions. Their local time axes restart at 0 s. Stimulus-addition time and the delay to the first F1 read are not recorded.
Gain settings are not explicitly exported. Ratios are descriptive and depend on comparable acquisition settings; same excitation/emission labels alone do not verify identical gain.

User supplied 1:100 VUAA1 dilution, 1:1000 odorant dilution and 0.1% DMSO for the solutions. Stock molar concentrations and preparation recipes are not supplied, so final molarity and formulation cannot be independently checked from the exports.
DMSO-subtracted values compare different wells and acquisitions, not a same-well counterfactual. A positive contrast can arise because the DMSO well decreases more.
Mean F1 uses all 15 readings (0-168 s); mean F0 uses all 5 readings (0-48 s). Early-window (F1 0-48 s), first-reading and final-three-reading alternatives are retained as sensitivity summaries.
No independent biological replication, statistical significance, detection limit or receptor specificity is established by this batch.
